name: Dura-Ace power-meter crankset
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average 745 g for FC-R9200-PX, 170 mm crank arms and 50/34T chainrings, explicitly excluding the bottom bracket. Includes the integrated power meter. Shimano lists PX as an R9100 range option; it remains distinct from FC-R9200-P. Other chainring combinations do not inherit this mass.
